nd54458f5c4f.s: The principal beneficiaries of ICDS are:
o: Children aged 6–14 years and pregnant women
Children aged six months to six years, pregnant women and lactating mothers
Pregnant women and lactating mothers only
nd54458f5c4f.x: ICDS primarily covers children from six months to six years, pregnant women and lactating mothers.

n92f016c6303.s: Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi primarily seeks to:
o: Provide one hot cooked meal to children in Classes I–VIII
Provide cash maternity benefit to pregnant women
Bring early childhood care and education into Anganwadis through play-based pedagogy
Provide take-home ration to adolescent girls
n92f016c6303.x: Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi integrates ECCE into Anganwadis and promotes play-based pedagogy, effectively developing them as pre-schools.

n4188a191555.s:
Arrange in chronological order:
A. Launch of ICDS
B. Universalisation of ICDS
C. Introduction of the Mid-Day Meal Scheme
D. Introduction of Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0
n4188a191555.x: ICDS was launched in 1975, the Mid-Day Meal Scheme came in 1995, ICDS was universalised in 2006, and Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0 was introduced in 2021.

n16d5cd8645b.s: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK) entitles pregnant women and sick newborns to:
o: A cash incentive for institutional delivery
A free antenatal check-up on the 9th of every month
Rs 5,000 maternity benefit for the first child
Free delivery, drugs, diagnostics, blood, diet and transport
n16d5cd8645b.x: JSSK, launched in 2011 under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, provides pregnant women and sick newborns free delivery, medicines, diagnostics, blood, diet and transport.

n2ed066b4994.s: On 1 July 2026, the Allahabad High Court held that the age limits under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act apply:
o: Only to persons not governed by personal laws
To all citizens irrespective of religion
Only to residents of Uttar Pradesh
n2ed066b4994.x: The Allahabad High Court held that the PCMA age limits apply to all citizens irrespective of religion.

n0f564f25389.s: PM CARES for Children provides eligible COVID-19 orphaned children a corpus of ____ at the age of 23.
n0f564f25389.x: PM CARES for Children (2021), for children who lost parents or guardians to COVID-19, provides a corpus of Rs 10 lakh at 23 along with education and health support.

n45bd8af96b1.s: The Supreme Court directed that prison manuals be revised to ensure accessibility for prisoners with disabilities in line with:
o: The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
The Rehabilitation Council of India Act, 1992
n45bd8af96b1.x: The Supreme Court directed prison accessibility and revision of prison manuals in accordance with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.

nindian-society-50-16.s: Which of the following pairs about the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act is correctly matched?
nindian-society-50-16.x: The RPwD Act was passed in 2016 and came into force on 19 April 2017; it reserves 4% of government jobs and 5% of higher-education seats.

n5fb616849f8.s:
Consider the following statements about the Optional Protocol to the UNCRPD:
1. It provides an individual complaints mechanism.
2. India has ratified it.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n5fb616849f8.x: The Optional Protocol provides an individual complaints mechanism, but India has not ratified it.

nindian-society-37-37.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The UDID Portal comes under the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD).
2. The PM-DAKSH Portal comes under DEPwD.
3. The PRASHAST App comes under DEPwD.
Which of the above statements are correct?
nindian-society-37-37.x: UDID and PM-DAKSH come under DEPwD; PRASHAST comes under Education (NCERT/DoSEL), so statement 3 is false.

n6306e2e8ae6.s: UDID-based skilling and the Divyangjan Rozgar Setu for jobs are features of which portal introduced in 2023?
n6306e2e8ae6.x: The PM-DAKSH-DEPwD portal provides UDID-based skilling and the Divyangjan Rozgar Setu for employment opportunities.

n0afb4ef7567.s: Which of the following correctly describes ALIMCO?
o: A statutory authority that monitors implementation of the RPwD Act
A National Trust scheme providing health insurance
A Central Public Sector Enterprise set up in 1972 that makes aids and artificial limbs
A corporation that gives concessional loans for self-employment of Divyangjan
n0afb4ef7567.x: ALIMCO is a Central Public Sector Enterprise established in 1972 that manufactures aids and artificial limbs; the other descriptions fit the Chief Commissioner, Niramaya and NDFDC.

nffc35821cd2.s: The target group of special education is:
nffc35821cd2.x: The target group for special education is children with disabilities, or CwSN; it is not a programme exclusively for gifted groups.

n1b6f5ae8239.s: Which provision lets the Tribunal declare void a senior citizen's property transfer when the transferee fails to provide the promised care?
o: Section 12 of the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007
Section 23 of the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007
Section 20 of the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007
Section 32 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
n1b6f5ae8239.x: Section 23 of the 2007 Act permits the Tribunal to declare such a transfer void when the promised basic needs and care are not provided.

n56625dc9a1b.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act – 2007
National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly – 1999
n56625dc9a1b.x: The Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act dates to 2007; NPOP is 1999, NPHCE began in 2010–11 and NPSC is 2011.

nindian-society-37-18.s:
Consider the following statements about the SEED Scheme Portal:
1. It enables online applications from DNT communities for health insurance, coaching and housing assistance.
2. It is administered by the National Testing Agency.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-society-37-18.x: The SEED portal takes DNT applications for health insurance, coaching and housing, but it is run by the Department of Social Justice, not the NTA.

nindian-society-1-40.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-society-1-40.x: The Communal Award came in 1932. The National Integration Council began in 1961 and the National Foundation for Communal Harmony in 1992.

nindian-society-42-32.s:
Consider the following statements about the Justice Rajindar Sachar Committee:
1. It was constituted in 2006.
2. It was a Prime Minister's High-Level Committee.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-society-42-32.x: The Sachar Committee was a Prime Minister's High-Level Committee set up in March 2005; it reported in November 2006.

n5604f8b1f35.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: National Commission for Religious and Linguistic Minorities – Amitabh Kundu
n5604f8b1f35.x: The Post-Sachar Evaluation Committee was chaired by Amitabh Kundu; the Sachar Committee by Rajinder Sachar and the minorities commission by Justice Ranganath Misra.

nc71796726da.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: FPO mark – Industrial and consumer products
nc71796726da.x: Hallmark certifies gold and silver jewellery. ISI is for industrial and consumer products, Agmark for agricultural produce and FPO for processed fruit products.

n9d326f02048.s:
Consider the following statements about the historical roots of India's foreign policy:
1. The freedom struggle produced anti-colonialism.
2. It contributed to Asian solidarity.
3. Nehru's broadcast of 7 September 1946 expressed independence from power blocs.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
n9d326f02048.x: All three describe the historical influence on India's foreign policy, including Nehru's 7 September 1946 broadcast.

n9d2b48cdf32.s:
Consider the following statements about Panchsheel:
1. It was absorbed into the Bandung Ten Principles in 1955.
2. A UN General Assembly resolution recognised it as a principle of international law in 1957.
3. The Belgrade NAM Summit made it a core principle in 1961.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
n9d2b48cdf32.x: Panchsheel entered the Bandung framework in 1955, was recognised by a UNGA resolution in 1957 and became a core NAM principle at Belgrade in 1961.

n0debcf9306f.s:
Assertion (A): Strategic autonomy is not the same as neutrality.
Reason (R): Strategic autonomy permits India to judge each issue on its merits without joining military blocs.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n0debcf9306f.x: Both are true, and the meaning of strategic autonomy (judging each issue on merits without joining blocs) explains why it is not neutrality.

n86892cfff87.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Jawaharlal Nehru – Look East and economic diplomacy
Rajiv Gandhi – India-Sri Lanka Accord and IPKF
P.V. Narasimha Rao – Indo-Soviet Treaty and Bangladesh 1971
n86892cfff87.x: Rajiv Gandhi is associated with the India-Sri Lanka Accord and IPKF. Nehru goes with non-alignment and Panchsheel, Indira Gandhi with the Indo-Soviet Treaty and 1971, and Narasimha Rao with Look East.

n926ee85ebed.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n926ee85ebed.x: The Simla Agreement was between Indira Gandhi and Z.A. Bhutto. Tashkent involved Shastri and Ayub Khan, Lahore involved Vajpayee and Nawaz Sharif, and the Indo-Soviet Treaty was India–USSR.

nd43dfce4dcd.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Macartney-MacDonald Line – Places Aksai Chin in Ladakh
McMahon Line – Places Aksai Chin under China
Johnson Line – Places Aksai Chin in Ladakh
Johnson Line – Eastern boundary between Tibet and India
nd43dfce4dcd.x: The Johnson Line places Aksai Chin in Ladakh. The Macartney-MacDonald Line places it under China, and the McMahon Line is the eastern Tibet-India boundary.

n195d5ea3432.s:
Consider the following statements about the India-Bangladesh Land Boundary Agreement:
1. It was signed in 1974.
2. It was implemented in 2015 through the 100th Constitutional Amendment.
3. It involved exchange of 111 Indian and 51 Bangladeshi enclaves.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
n195d5ea3432.x: All three are correct: the 1974 agreement settled the boundary through exchange of enclaves and was implemented in 2015 under the 100th Amendment.

nb22dd2f29a4.s: Which of the following project–country pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
nb22dd2f29a4.x: The Russia-built Rooppur nuclear plant is in Bangladesh, not Sri Lanka. Arun III is in Nepal, Mangdechhu in Bhutan and Maitree (Rampal) in Bangladesh.
